{{Quote|Ord Tiddell is the largest casualty in a bizarre series of stone mites infestations spreading throughout the Colonies and Mid Rim. Worlds as spread apart as Havricus, Sermeria, Tynna, Nar Bo Sholla and Deylerax have reported damage from stone mites, though nothing on Ord Tiddell's scale.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN" />}}
'''Ord Tiddell''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tennuutta sector/Legends|Tennuutta sector]]. Having served as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] it fell victim to a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide infestation of [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]]. The [[Silicate/Legends|silicate]]-and-metal-[[Diet/Legends|eating]] [[Arthropod/Legends|arthropods]] caused the ruination of Ord Tiddell's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Lagabee]], and the world's population subsequently underwent a mass exodus.

==Description==
Ord Tiddell was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="HNN" /> located in the [[Ord Tiddell system/Legends|Ord Tiddell system]], a part of the [[Tennuutta sector/Legends|Tennuutta sector]]<ref name="EAOC Tiddell" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC Tiddell" />

==History==
{{Quote|The state capital of Ord Tiddell now lies in ruins, its foundation having been repeatedly perforated by the voracious appetites of thousands of stone mites. Much of Ord Tiddell's capital city of Lagabee has been abandoned, and the planet's population of four million is in the midst of a mass exodus.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN" />}}
[[File:OrdTiddell-EGTW.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Ord Tiddell served as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost during the Pius Dea Era.]]
Ord Tiddell served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]]. During that time, the world was located just outside the Republic's borders.<ref name="EGTW" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_3.html|Stone Mites Claim Ord Tiddell}} is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:5:9," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Ord Tiddell became one of the several worlds of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that experienced an infestation of [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]]&mdash;[[Arthropod/Legends|arthropods]] [[Diet/Legends|feeding]] on [[Silicate/Legends|silicates]] and complex metals. Thousands of the ravenous creatures perforated the foundation of the planet's state [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Lagabee]], with much of the ruined [[City/Legends|city]] subsequently becoming abandoned, and the world's population, which numbered four million, underwent a mass exodus.<ref name="HNN" />

Ord Tiddell was by far the most affected world of the stone mites' [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] infestation, losing billions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in capital assets and business revenue. The [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judical Department]] of the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] both carried out investigations on the disaster, and at least one [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] rescue worker was present at a demolished site on the planet. On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:5:9, the infestation on Ord Tiddell was reported in an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ord Tiddell was first featured in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 55|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #55'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the HoloNet News<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]], illustrated by [[Joe Corroney]],<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[May 9]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN55 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6774521|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-05-09|time=4:55 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220611192020/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-14}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ord Tiddell [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square Q-7.<ref name="TEA" />
